description: Best-effort Mode 21 hybrid coverage for the 5th-generation RAV4 Hybrid (XA50, 2019+) and RAV4 Prime PHEV (2021+). Both share the TNGA-K platform and THS-II hybrid drivetrain with the 2020 Lexus RX 450h/450hL, so this profile inherits the high-confidence hybrid PIDs validated against Nathan's RX 450hL: MG1/MG2/MGR torques (PIDs 61/62/63), HV pack voltage (PID 98), and four battery cell-block temperatures (PID 95). Includes additional candidate PIDs from the generic-toyota-hybrid profile (SOC real/display, MG RPMs) that may or may not respond on this platform — they're auto-demoted at probe time if they don't. UNVALIDATED on real RAV4 hardware; treat as a starting point and run a held-state PID sweep to confirm.
sources: Inherited from src/profiles/builtin/generic-toyota-hybrid.json (community Toyota HSD PID list)

validated_against.notes: Scaffolded for an upcoming rental trip — PIDs are inherited from the 2020 Lexus RX 450hL profile (validated TNGA-K + THS-II platform) and the generic-toyota-hybrid profile (community-curated). The high-confidence subset (PIDs 61/62/63/95/98 on hybrid_controller) should work on any TNGA-K THS-II vehicle. The medium-confidence subset (PIDs 8B/8C/CE/CF) is included because the generic Toyota hybrid community list reports them on Prius/Camry/RAV4 hybrids, but they're untested on TNGA-K specifically — the app's strike-rehab probe demotes any PID that returns NO_DATA after 3 consecutive ticks, so unsupported PIDs disappear automatically. PID 63 (MGR torque) will return NO_DATA on FWD (non-AWD) RAV4 Hybrid trims. To validate: capture a raw-mode session and check that PIDs 61/62/95/98 show varying responses across idle / cruise / accel windows, and that MG2 torque sign flips negative during regen braking.
